raw_text: Fresh satellite images released by Pakistan military authorities appear to show the Balakot madrasa complex standing undamaged, contradicting India's claims of a successful surgical strike in 2019. However, independent geospatial analysts have noted the images appear to be selectively cropped, omitting areas where damage was previously documented by international media.
clean_text: Dawn reports Pakistan military released satellite images showing Balakot madrasa undamaged. Independent analysts note images appear selectively cropped, omitting previously documented damage areas.
